## 💡 Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## 🎯 Problem It Solves

What problem does this feature solve? What use case does it address?

## 💭 Proposed Solution

How should this feature work? Describe the ideal implementation.

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered

Have you considered any alternative solutions or features?

## 📸 Mockups/Examples

If applicable, add mockups, screenshots, or examples.

## 🔗 Related Issues

Link to any related issues or discussions.

## 📚 Additional Context

Add any other context, examples, or use cases here.

## 🤝 Willing to Contribute?

- [ ] I'm willing to implement this feature
- [ ] I need help getting started
- [ ] I just want to suggest it

---

**Note:** This project was built in 24 hours as a foundation. We welcome all ideas, especially those that help make it production-ready!
